count_interpretation.24_observed_cells: Correctly counts the 12 observed-on output records at each optimization level; the other four fixture processes still execute kernels but do not emit observer records.
count_interpretation.72_actual_helper_calls: Correctly counts one selected radius-helper invocation for each of 12 case IDs in each of six fixture processes (bridge-off, observed-off, observed-on at O0 and O2).
count_interpretation.case_uniqueness: The 12 IDs comprise 10 distinct constructed input states: case 11 duplicates case 1 and case 12 duplicates case 3 as repeat/state-leak controls. Avoid describing them as 12 unique meteorological profiles.

scope: Read-only review of isolated liquid-radius comparison source and saved receipt metadata. No compiler, fixture, model, RTE, or raw stdout execution/read by reviewer.

technical_scope.conditional_number_arm: Raw and density-scaled number-input cases are explicitly labeled as conditional hypotheses; no conversion or unit/population authority is established.
technical_scope.gamma_check: The independent gamma-moment algebra checks consistency of the selected Thompson liquid kernel and its inputs. It does not show that UDM uses the same PSD or that either result matches a production cloud-optics LUT.
technical_scope.kernels: Mode 8 fixed-volume Thompson liquid kernel, mode 28 aerosol-aware Thompson liquid kernel, and mode 27 UDM liquid radius helper, using compiled modules and the source-pinned isolated fixture.
not_covered: full Thompson initialization or production physics routing
technical_scope.thompson_initialization: A reversible test bridge sets the private aerosol-awareness flag and inverse exponent needed by this kernel. It intentionally bypasses thompson_init and does not initialize host microphysics tables/state.
